01

Setting specification

Task

Estimate $\tau=\log\det(A)=\operatorname{tr}(\log A)$, with the matrix logarithm defined by spectral decomposition.

Admissible model

Assume $A=A^{\mathsf T}\succ0$ and $A\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$, with $\mu I\preceq A\preceq\beta I$, $0<\mu\le\beta$, and $\beta/\mu\le\kappa$.

Oracle interface

The information $d,\mu,\beta,\kappa,\eta,\delta$ is public and $A$ is hidden. Query $v\in\mathbb{R}^d$ returns exact $Av$. Neither $\log(A)v$ nor a shifted inverse action is available for free.

Output

Return any real $\widehat\tau$. No explicit matrix logarithm, determinant, or verifiable certificate is required.

Loss or accuracy criterion

The base loss is $|\widehat\tau-\log\det(A)|$, with success threshold $\eta$. Positive eigenvalues ensure that the matrix logarithm and target are finite.

Resource accounting

Count right products with single vectors only: $N=N_{\mathrm r}$. A block of width $q$ costs $q$ calls.

The budget bounds calls for every fixed input and every private seed. Reading public inputs, exact real arithmetic, storage, and postprocessing are free. One call applies the interface to one vector.

Algorithm views and success guarantees

Algorithms may use private randomness and choose query vectors adaptively from the declared domain using all previous responses. Queries and outputs may be arbitrary measurable functions of the transcript; no Krylov or linear-span restriction applies. Exact internal arithmetic, storage, and communication are free in this oracle model. A block query is charged by its number of columns.

The algorithm is selected using public inputs only. For every admissible input fixed before generation of the private seed, success probability over private randomness is at least $1-\delta$.

Budget convention
A fixed worst-case budget respected for every input and private seed.

Algorithm scope
Algorithms may use private randomness and choose query vectors adaptively from the declared domain using all previous responses. Queries and outputs may be arbitrary measurable functions of the transcript; no Krylov or linear-span restriction applies. Exact internal arithmetic, storage, and communication are free in this oracle model. A block query is charged by its number of columns.
Correspondence, constants and qualifications
Oracle correspondence
Only exact Av is available. Products log(A)v, linear solves, and preconditioners are not free interfaces. Each Lanczos iteration consumes one native right-product query.
Guarantee conversion
Success probability is at least 1 − δ for each fixed SPD input. Sampling and truncation parameters must use the same verified error allocation.
Output rule
Return a real estimate of logdet(A) with absolute error at most η. Retain the public positive spectral interval [μ,β]; relative log-determinant error is a different target.
Resource conversion
Count only right multiplication by a single vector, $N=N_{\mathrm r}$. A block product of width $q$ costs $q$ calls. The worst-case cap holds for every input and random seed; it is not an expected call count. Reading public inputs and exact internal arithmetic, storage, and postprocessing are uncharged. This budget does not certify running time or bit complexity.
Constants
Universal constants, with only the parameter dependence permitted by this bound’s region and expression.
Derivation
Each Lanczos step costs one Av product. If the Krylov subspace becomes invariant early, the quadratic form is computed exactly. Replacing the actual condition number kappa(A) by the public upper bound kappa only enlarges the two monotone sufficient budgets. Probe count and step count must arise from the same parameter choice.
